olivia_csm: Quick request 10pocket card0for customers going live. Short checklist + escalation triggers for priming (cache/batch/stream).
kevin_eng: I'll sketch a 6-line checklist and two tiny config snippets customers can hand to infra.
jess_cs: Please add a 1-sentence customer blurb we can paste in calendar invites.
olivia_csm: Blurb idea: 'We0will run a short priming job to warm model instances and cache common prefixes so early users see low latency.'
kevin_eng: Customer checklist (copy-paste):
1) Preflight: confirm model pin + service account perms.
2) Approve 30min priming window.
3) Priming run: prefill ~20 representative flows; warm_pool=2.
4) Runtime: batch.max_requests=6 (smaller for low traffic); cache_ttl=600s; streaming=on for UX.
5) Post-check: run 5 golden prompts, report avg latency + any odd outputs.
6) Escalate if thresholds hit (see below).
sam_sre: Tiny config snippets for infra teams to copy: 
`priming: {enabled:true, prefill:20, warm_pool:2}`
`serving: {batch:{max_requests:6}, cache_ttl_seconds:600, streaming:true}`
kevin_eng: Telemetry snippets to paste into Console: 
`errors_per_minute(tenant="${tenant}")`
`avg_latency_ms(model="${model}", window=5m)`
`success_rate(prompt_set="golden", window=1h)`
sam_sre: Escalation triggers (operational):
- errors > 3x baseline for 10m -> page #eng-oncall
- golden success rate drop >= 30% over 1h -> open ticket + notif AM
- avg latency >= 2x baseline for 15m -> run fallback (route smaller model) + page oncall
Also automation: alert -> create ticket tag onboarding:high-risk.
jess_cs: Post-priming customer touch template: 
Subject: "Priming complete 1 quick check"
Body bullets: "1) Did outputs match expectations? (Yes/No) 2) Avg latency (ms) 3) Any errors/timeouts or surprising completions?"
olivia_csm: Troubleshooting steps (in order): 1) confirm model pin and quantization 2) verify warm_pool > 0 and prefill completed 3) drop batch.max_requests to lower tail latency 4) toggle streaming=false if connection errors 5) revert model if quality issues.
kevin_eng: Note: streaming improves perceived latency but increases concurrent connections and memory. For small customers prefer lower batch sizes or disable streaming to keep latency predictable.
opsbot: Created internal priming job template -> /ops/templates/priming-pocketcard.yaml :white_check_mark:
